chain_placement: Two well-separated rings spread across board; exclude fish rings and outer rings containing smaller rings.
chain_behavior: While lock count > 0, both rotation and board exit are locked. Each other Ring or Stick exiting reduces count by one.
chain_count: Choose per level according to opening route and target difficulty. Solve and simulate after applying; no fixed count schedule.
fish_initial_coverage: No initial coverage by ring, stick, pin, StopPin, jaw or bomb.
fish_sweep: Use pin/bomb sweep-risk positions only when better choices exhausted.
fish_alignment: Avoid horizontal/vertical alignment as secondary preference.
